name: Nisha Parmar
card: Nisha Parmar is a thirty-seven-year-old physiotherapist in Vadodara who joined through an affiliate link over two years ago and shops on her Android phone. She's a gold loyalty member with points she hasn't used yet. She visits often, browsing fashion, home and electronics. Lately she has bought silk sarees and some casual menswear, like a linen shirt, slim jeans and leather sandals. She has returned a couple of orders and sometimes leaves carts without buying. Of the many offers she has received, she claimed a few, used two on orders and dismissed one.
